stem: Voltmarkt cut TV prices in the same weeks as a rival's big TV promotion, and Voltmarkt's TV sales stayed flat. A colleague concludes the price cut had no effect. What is the flaw?

options.text: Flat sales prove the price cut changed nothing
The rival's deal may have pulled sales down as the cut pushed them up
Price cuts always raise sales, so the sales data for those weeks must be wrong
TV sales are too small to show any correlation with price
